# Palazzo Usellini

> Historic 18th-century residence in Arona on Lake Maggiore (Italy), member of ADSI (Associazione Dimore Storiche Italiane). Architectural heritage of neoclassical and Dutch Baroque influences, secular Italian gardens, and active cultural venue for classical chamber music concerts.

Palazzo Usellini (also referred to historically as Casa Usellini) is an authentic architectural complex located in the historic center of Arona (Piedmont, Italy) at Via Pertossi 12. Dating back to 1530 with major 1783 architectural works commissioned by merchant Carlantonio Usellini, the palace features a three-winged portico courtyard, historic service buildings ("gli Stallini" and "le Casacce"), and an expansive private garden. It regularly hosts the prestigious "Lago Maggiore Musica" festival, theatrical performances, and cultural initiatives.

## Location & Practical Info

- Address: Via Pertossi 12, 28041 Arona (NO), Piedmont, Italy
- Coordinates: Latitude 45.7602° N, Longitude 8.5606° E
- Public Access: Open during scheduled concert evenings, cultural rassegne, and heritage openings (ADSI National Days).
